title: GARCH(1,1) conditional volatility model fit with forecasts at 1d/7d/30d horizons
description: GARCH(1,1) conditional volatility model fit with forecasts at 1d/7d/30d horizons. Returns model parameters (omega, alpha_1, beta_1), persistence (alpha+beta), half-life in days (if stationary), and annualized conditional vol. Built via arch package on ohlcv_4h returns. Informational research data — not investment advice.
